autoCreateTopic.title: Auto Create Topic
autoCreateTopic.description: Setting the auto-creation of the topic

batchEnabled.title: Batch Enabled
batchEnabled.description: Define if we are publishing a single message or a batch

headerFilterStrategy.title: Header Filter Strategy
headerFilterStrategy.description: To use a custom HeaderFilterStrategy to map headers to/from Camel.

kmsMasterKeyId.title: Kms Master Key Id
kmsMasterKeyId.description: The ID of an AWS-managed customer master key (CMK) for Amazon SNS or a custom CMK.

messageDeduplicationIdStrategy.title: Message Deduplication Id Strategy
messageDeduplicationIdStrategy.description: Only for FIFO Topic. Strategy for setting the messageDeduplicationId on the message. It can be one of the following options: useExchangeId, useContentBasedDeduplication. For the useContentBasedDeduplication option, no messageDeduplicationId will be set on the message.

messageGroupIdStrategy.title: Message Group Id Strategy
messageGroupIdStrategy.description: Only for FIFO Topic. Strategy for setting the messageGroupId on the message. It can be one of the following options: useConstant, useExchangeId, usePropertyValue. For the usePropertyValue option, the value of property CamelAwsSnsMessageGroupId will be used.

messageStructure.title: Message Structure
messageStructure.description: The message structure to use such as json

overrideEndpoint.title: Override Endpoint
overrideEndpoint.description: Set the need for overriding the endpoint. This option needs to be used in combination with the uriEndpointOverride option

policy.title: Policy
policy.description: The policy for this topic. Is loaded by default from classpath, but you can prefix with classpath:, file:, or http: to load the resource from different systems.

queueArn.title: Queue Arn
queueArn.description: The ARN endpoint to subscribe to

region.title: Region
region.description: The region in which the SNS client needs to work. When using this parameter, the configuration will expect the lowercase name of the region (for example, ap-east-1) You'll need to use the name Region.EU_WEST_1.id()

serverSideEncryptionEnabled.title: Server Side Encryption Enabled
serverSideEncryptionEnabled.description: Define if Server Side Encryption is enabled or not on the topic

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: The subject which is used if the message header 'CamelAwsSnsSubject' is not present.

subscribeSNStoSQS.title: Subscribe SNSto SQS
subscribeSNStoSQS.description: Define if the subscription between SNS Topic and SQS must be done or not

uriEndpointOverride.title: Uri Endpoint Override
uriEndpointOverride.description: Set the overriding uri endpoint. This option needs to be used in combination with overrideEndpoint option

lazyStartProducer.title: Lazy Start Producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

amazonSNSClient.title: Amazon SNSClient
amazonSNSClient.description: To use the AmazonSNS as the client

proxyHost.title: Proxy Host
proxyHost.description: To define a proxy host when instantiating the SNS client

proxyPort.title: Proxy Port
proxyPort.description: To define a proxy port when instantiating the SNS client

proxyProtocol.title: Proxy Protocol
proxyProtocol.description: To define a proxy protocol when instantiating the SNS client

profileCredentialsName.title: Profile Credentials Name
profileCredentialsName.description: If using a profile credentials provider, this parameter will set the profile name

sessionToken.title: Session Token
sessionToken.description: Amazon AWS Session Token used when the user needs to assume an IAM role

trustAllCertificates.title: Trust All Certificates
trustAllCertificates.description: If we want to trust all certificates in case of overriding the endpoint

useDefaultCredentialsProvider.title: Use Default Credentials Provider
useDefaultCredentialsProvider.description: Set whether the SNS client should expect to load credentials on an AWS infra instance or to expect static credentials to be passed in.

useProfileCredentialsProvider.title: Use Profile Credentials Provider
useProfileCredentialsProvider.description: Set whether the SNS client should expect to load credentials through a profile credentials provider.

useSessionCredentials.title: Use Session Credentials
useSessionCredentials.description: Set whether the SNS client should expect to use Session Credentials. This is useful in a situation in which the user needs to assume an IAM role for doing operations in SNS.
